issues: 行内图标是 ◎ ✉ ◧ ◈ ★ ↺ ⚑ 七个风格不一的 unicode 符号，粗细、基线、字形来源都不统一
背景是平涂 #F3F3F1，药丸只有一层 0 2px 8px 阴影，焦点行没有被"托起来"
吸附走位的快段（峰值约 54px/帧）完全锐利，滚轮缺少速度感；外侧 AI 徽标是一块平黑方块
上下渐隐是叠在列表上的纸色色块，背景只要不是纯色就会露出矩形边界
changes: 图标换成同一套 16 网格 1.5 描边线性图标（清理/私信/分群/批量/奖励/自动流/实验），焦点行图标用唯一强调色 #5b63d3，可见性规则 max(0,1−d·1.6) 不变
纸面底加偏左上的柔和顶光 + 0.12 暗角 + 极弱颗粒，药丸身后一抹白色光池；药丸补顶沿内高光与近实远虚两层软影，scaleY 呼吸不变
列表按位置函数求纵向速度，走位快段给 SpeedBlur 竖向拖影（封顶 0.8 设计 px），outQuint 减速吸附与 HOLD 静止段自动归零
渐隐改为 mask-image alpha 遮罩，背景换渐变也无边界带；AI 徽标改深色渐变 + 内高光 + 浅靛小星芒；改用 raster="zoom" 原生栅格化
STEPS=5、HOLD=5/14、窗口 0.05→0.95、三通道距离衰减等全部参数不变
issuesEn: Row icons were seven mismatched unicode symbols (◎ ✉ ◧ ◈ ★ ↺ ⚑) with different weights, baselines and font sources
The background is a flat #F3F3F1 and the pill has a single 0 2px 8px shadow, so the focus row is never lifted
The fast part of each snap (peaking near 54px/frame) is razor sharp, so the wheel has no sense of speed; the AI badge is a flat black block
The top/bottom fade is a paper-coloured block laid over the list, exposing a rectangle as soon as the background isn't a flat colour
changesEn: Icons are one 16-grid 1.5-stroke line set (cleanup / message / segments / batch / reward / flows / testing), with the focus icon in the single accent #5b63d3; the max(0,1−d·1.6) visibility rule is unchanged

The paper gets a soft upper-left key light, 0.12 vignette and faint grain, plus a white light pool behind the pill; the pill gains a top inner highlight and a two-layer contact/ambient shadow, keeping its scaleY breath
List velocity is derived from the position function, so the fast part of each move gets a vertical SpeedBlur (capped at 0.8 design px) that falls to zero during the outQuint snap and HOLD
The fade is now a mask-image alpha mask with no boundary on a gradient background; the AI badge gets a dark gradient, inner highlight and a pale indigo sparkle; switched to raster="zoom"
STEPS=5, HOLD=5/14, the 0.05→0.95 window and the three-channel distance falloff are all unchanged
